title: Attachment Therapy
description:
For male listeners/good boys 💋 You’ve been coming to see me for counseling for some detachment issues you’ve been having lately. As our sessions have progressed, we’ve gotten closer and closer. Today, you show up on my doorstep for our session, in the rain, and I can feel it. I can tell what your heart aches for.

You need to be praised, to let go, to be close to someone. My voice is so comforting. I make it so easy to surrender. You never want to stop listening to my voice. You never want to be apart from me.

By the time I’m done with you, you’ll be helplessly, hopelessly in love. I’ll slowly unravel you, until your heart fully belongs to me.

And when you’ve given me everything, only then will you be allowed to release. But not until you say it. 🫦

Love,

Nichole
author: Goddess Nichole
